summary: Full backend + frontend verification of AlzNexus. 17/17 pytest backend tests passed (root, agents seeded >=10, runs list, run 404, insights filters verdict/starred, stats, audit filters, learnings, star toggle + 404, schedule validation + CRUD + trigger 404, cron auth/unauth/duplicate dedupe, run validation + launch). Launched exactly 1 manual run which started progressing through steps without any 429 concurrent_request_limit error (LLM serialization fix confirmed). All 8 frontend pages load without console errors and all requested data-testids are present on their pages. Theme toggle switches html dark class correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: No element has data-testid="stats" on dashboard (only insight-quality-chart and recent-runs are tagged). If the review spec requires a stats testid, add it to the KPI cards wrapper.

action_items: Optional: Add data-testid="stats" to the dashboard KPI cards wrapper if that selector is required by downstream tooling.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); migrate to lifespan context manager.
list_runs limit (default 50) and audit limit (300) have no upper cap and no pagination - could return large payloads over time; consider enforcing max limit via Query(..., le=500).
cron_tick persists dedupe records in cron_runs forever; add TTL index on received_at to prevent unbounded growth.
run_due_schedules is fire-and-forget via asyncio.create_task; if cron fires frequently, concurrent schedule evaluations could double-trigger. Consider a lock or `findOneAndUpdate` guard per schedule.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 manual run via POST /api/runs (goal starting with 'TEST_') to verify launch and LLM concurrency fix; it was intentionally left to progress (will complete in ~7 min). Any TEST_ schedules created during tests were deleted by the fixture.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_alznexus.py (pytest). Uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL + WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET from env. Only one new run was launched during this iteration due to LLM concurrency constraints. All sidebar routes and testids verified via Playwright on preview URL.
